description: Chart 2 of 2 on book p. 30 (SD(SY)-8). The chart has no arrow, so the first code of the title is the subject: DEF (definition) (the title writes DIFF), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of"; AFL (affinity alignment) is the partner. From the subject: AGT (agreement). From AGT: AF-DT (affinity dictates). From AF-DT: TM (terminology—or terms of a definition), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of"; POST (postulation), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of"; OBS (observation); and EXT-DY (extended dynamics). From EXT-DY: IST-F (isolated focus). From IST-F: MTA-IMP (meta-implications) and LANG-DY (language dynamics). The page text speaks of "the present affinity alignment of creativity and information dynamics".
